entries.description: Authored spec.md (3-session plan: GroupLevel source fix + ModuleName in Session 1, integration test in Session 2, docs update in Session 3). Authored ai-assignment.md via route(task_type=analysis). Key pre-session finding: AccessTextParser produces 'GroupLevel 0' (space-separated) child nodes for GroupLevel configuration, not flat Properties keys â€” current extractor reads wrong source.

Rewrote ReportMetadataExtractor.BuildGroupLevels: replaced flat-Properties GroupLevel<N> key approach with scan of 'GroupLevel N' (space-separated) child nodes for per-level metadata (GroupOnCol->GroupOn, GroupOn code->GroupingMode, SortOrder, KeepTogether, GroupInterval). Added GroupLevelConfigRegex. Added decoding tables for GroupingMode (0=EachValue..9=Interval), SortOrder (0=Ascending, 1=Descending), KeepTogether (0=None, 1=WholeGroup, 2=WithFirstDetail). Config nodes filtered out of meta.Children (code-review finding: they bled into Children alongside design-band sections). Removed consumedGroupLevelKeys. Updated GroupLevel tests to use 'GroupLevel 0' child nodes; added decoding tests for all codes; added config-node-exclusion test.

Added AccessObjectReader.ReadModuleName: scans first 10 lines of VbaCode for Attribute VB_Name = '...' line, returns quoted value or null. Wired into FormMetadataExtractor and ReportMetadataExtractor. Replaced deferred-null ModuleName tests with extraction tests (VB_Name present, absent, VbaCode absent) in both test files.
dotnet build clean (0 errors). dotnet test AccessHarvester.Tests: 436 active passing, 2 SkippableFact skipped. No regressions.

Routed code review (sonnet, complexity_hint=55). ISSUES_FOUND: 1 real bug â€” GroupLevel config nodes bled into meta.Children; fixed by filtering Type-matching GroupLevelConfigRegex nodes before assigning Children. Minor: added 10-line comment to ReadModuleName. Verifier (gemini-pro): VERIFIED.
Cross-provider session verification routed to gpt-5-4. VERIFIED on first round. Raw output saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
Verified Session 1 committed (commit b8d6469). Clean working tree.

Extended SyntheticMetadataExtractorIntegrationTests.AssertGroupLevels to conditionally assert GroupingMode, SortOrder, KeepTogether, GroupInterval from the expected fixture â€” same TryGetPropertyValue pattern as the existing GroupOn/HasHeader/HasFooter assertions. The 09-report-grouping-events.expected.json fixture was not updated with specific decoded values (no Access COM available to confirm actual pipeline output). The existing integration test already checks GroupOn, HasHeader, HasFooter. 436 active tests pass, 2 SkippableFact skipped.
Cross-provider session verification routed to gpt-5-4. VERIFIED first round. Raw output saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Updated docs/ir-schema-forms-reports.md: removed deferred-decoding notices for GroupingMode/SortOrder/KeepTogether/GroupInterval; updated ModuleName notes on FormMetadata and ReportMetadata; rewrote GroupLevel section with IR JSON source block, property-name quirk note, decoded-field mappings; updated worked examples (frmPatients gets ModuleName populated; rptSummaryByRegion uses GroupLevel <N> child node shape with decoded fields).

Routed doc review (gemini-flash, task_type=documentation). Returned three findings: one Major false-positive about GroupInterval wording (current wording is logically equivalent to the code behavior), one Minor consistency fix on ReportMetadata.DefaultView (applied — added null-on-unrecognized clause to match FormMetadata), one Minor pedagogy nit on GroupLevel.GroupOn (current wording is more informative; left as-is).

dotnet build clean (0 errors, 323 warnings — all pre-existing). dotnet test: Total 1362 tests; Passed 1315; Skipped 2; Failed 45 — all 45 failures isolated to AccessHarvester.SymbolDb.Tests and all are FileNotFoundException from missing tmp/comprehension-ir/AccessMetaData/NorthwindDevEdition/ kb JSON fixtures (tmp/ is gitignored; the fixtures are produced by running the harvester pipeline on NorthwindDevEdition.accdb which is gitignored per project-guidance.md). Verified pre-existing by stashing Session 3 changes and re-running the SymbolDb suite — same 45 failures. Unrelated to this session's docs-only change.

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4). Verdict: VERIFIED. Verifier confirmed: doc matches code, all targeted deferral notices removed, GroupLevel <N> child node source correctly documented, worked examples correctly updated. Verifier explicitly addressed the disclosed doc-review false-positives and agreed with the dismissals.

Generated change-log.md via route(task_type=summarization, max_tier=1) -> gemini-flash; tidied verifier-naming redundancy in-conversation. Generated next-session-set-recommendation.md via route(task_type=analysis) -> gemini-pro, grounded in docs/planning/strategy.md (plan-driven repo) and the harvester implementation plan. Recommendation: deviate from harvester-plan Phase 8 (cancelled) to strategy.md Phase 3c — generalization validation on MiniComplex/HomeHealthCare.
